what: Toolchains under the OS temp dir get purged. A toolchain cache placed under the OS temp directory worked at first, then silently broke once the OS reclaimed unread files there after a few days.
rule: Point toolchains at a stable, non-temp directory, and flag it plainly whenever one still resolves under the temp dir.
fix: Enforcement: a reusable report names the expected toolchains directory, whether it exists, and every configured path that still resolves under the temp dir; both diagnostics and onboarding surface it as advice, never a status change. Documentation: manifest reference.
